newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson signs 2 bln SKR deal with AT&T.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson signs 2 bln SKR deal with AT&T.

text.p: Swedish telecoms giant LM Ericsson AB on Thursday said it had won an order worth two billion crowns ($303.4 million) for mobile telephony from the U.S.'s AT&T Wireless Services.
Ericsson said this was the biggest order that Ericsson has signed with a U.S. buyer for mobile telephony. ($ = 6.591 Swedish Crowns)
Ericsson signs 2 bln SKR deal with =2
Under the agreement, Ericsson will supply digital PCS equipment and other mobile telephone equipment starting in January 1997.
AT&T will buy Ericsson's dual-mode telephones for both 800 and 1900 MHz TDMA-systems as well as single-band telephones for AT&T Digital PCS-clients.
The agreement includes the new analogue Ericsson telephone AF 738 as well as other analogue products.
"The agreement supports AT&T's strategy of supplying advanced wireless communication all over the U.S.," Ericsson said in a statement.
